tasks.short: Record rail-car conditions and maintenance work

steps.what: Review the actual car identity, observed conditions and repair/maintenance work performed or still required from the repairer's observations and work notes
inputs: actual car/unit identity and work order
repairer's actual observations, performed work and identified remaining work
outputs: repairer-reconciled actual car conditions and performed/planned work

steps.what: Record conditions of cars and repair and maintenance work performed or to be performed in rail maintenance work-order software (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: repairer-reconciled actual car conditions and performed/planned work
repairer's own spoken or typed description of actual work
outputs: complete candidate car-condition and maintenance entry

steps.what: Check and correct the completed actual condition/work entry, car identity, performed versus planned status, terminology and intended work-order record
inputs: complete candidate car-condition and maintenance entry
repairer-reconciled actual car conditions and performed/planned work
outputs: exact final checked condition/maintenance entry and intended car/work-order record

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual condition and maintenance entry to the intended car/work-order record
inputs: exact final checked condition/maintenance entry and intended car/work-order record
outputs: saved actual rail-car condition and maintenance record

tasks.design: Configure current car/work-order context and native verbatim dictation in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the rail maintenance work-order system. The repairer supplies the actual account, checks and corrects the complete text and identities, then saves only that exact checked entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Typing actual work descriptions and repeated unit identifiers adds record-entry effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native work-order context and verbatim dictation can reduce typing without creating maintenance facts.
tasks.still_hard: The record must distinguish observed conditions, completed work and work merely planned.
tasks.human_edge: Describe actual mechanical findings and take responsibility for the accurate maintenance account.

ambition.what: No automatic repair judgment, maintenance certification or return-to-service release.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2; rail maintenance records owner approves device access and dictation handling

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native work-order context and verbatim dictation can reduce manual record typing, while repair facts and final technical checking remain with the repairer.

assumptions: Unmeasured typed-record scenario. Gross 45 x .20 = 9; incremental upkeep 2; net 7 hours per 100.

Repairer produced actual observations and work facts during the repair; reviews them in s1, speaks/types and captures them in s2, and corrects the complete text in s3. No new structured defect codes, automatic narrative, missing parts list or ambient conversation transcript assumed free.

Native dictation is verbatim entry, not a model interpretation loop. Speaking, editing and technical term/number checking remain counted; if noisy conditions or terminology make it slower, use manual typing with zero gain.
Existing work-order identifiers already supplied today earn no saving. No new second-system re-key is invented; changes apply only where actual current typing exists.

Same-system save takes approximately zero today: 1 fully retained point, no saving. Final completed-entry check s3 gates exact content/car/work order; edits invalidate it. Ordinary authoring/checking is the gate, with no added self-approval step.
This records conditions and maintenance, not a release certificate or external send. No aircraft-specific regulatory rule from the digest is applied to rail cars.
unknowns: Actual typing burden, terminology accuracy and existing native dictation
research_questions: Does technician-spoken entry reduce total record time after every correction and technical check in actual workshop conditions?

already_counted.description: Actual-fact review, spoken/typed capture, correction and full technical entry checking

incremental.description: Maintain device/context settings and spot-check dictation performance after changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed actual car-condition/work entry and car/work-order destination checked in s3; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 typed-entry scenario below 7% modeled net; no saving if native context/dictation already works or correction erases benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Keep performed and planned work distinct
Check dictated technical terms, numbers and unit identities
Measure entry time including every correction
role.ambitious_version: Record actual rail-car findings with less repeated typing while repairers retain the complete technical account and all maintenance or release decisions.
